summary: Clarifies the definition of a secured zone in DNSSEC, updating RFC 2535 so a zone is secured or not regardless of the key algorithm used. It is on the standards track. It was replaced by RFC 4033, RFC 4034 and RFC 4035.

eli5.summary: A zone is either locked or not locked, no matter how many kinds of lock exist. Newer documents later replaced this.

questions: what is a secured dns zone
